_meta.description: Grille de déclinaison Pinterest par motif. Logique moteur de recherche (mots-clés longue traîne dans titre + description + texte image), PAS logique Etsy (tags courts). Vocabulaire consumer-facing : jamais de référence machine ni « fait main ».

format.note: Vertical 2:3 systématique. Texte en surimpression avec l'occasion.

_meta.logique_seo: 1 épingle = 1 mot-clé principal (début du titre + début de description + surimpression image) + 4-6 mots-clés secondaires répartis naturellement. Nom du board aussi riche en mots-clés.

hero.label: Hero — flatlay détail brodé
hero.role: Déclencheur de save : montre la personnalisation en 0,5 seconde.
hero.prompt: FLATLAY HERO — styled overhead flat composition, NO person, NO human body, NO face. Extreme focus on the embroidered detail (initial, name, motif) so the personalization reads instantly. The embroidered garment is styled flat on a warm textured surface (raw linen, pale wood, ceramic, dried flowers, a linen napkin, a coffee cup, seasonal natural props) with warm directional light and soft natural shadows. Editorial lifestyle flatlay, cozy and desirable. NEVER a clinical white studio background, NEVER a plain cut-out product shot. The embroidery is sharp and tactile, the thread texture clearly visible. Vertical 2:3 composition. Mood: 'I want this personalized for me'.

desir.label: Désir — porté serré sur la zone brodée
desir.role: Combine projection (porté) + lisibilité du détail brodé.
desir.prompt: WORN CLOSE-UP — the garment worn on the body, framed TIGHTLY on the embroidered zone (left chest, wrist / cuff, or back of neck depending on placement). Crop in close so the embroidered detail is large and perfectly legible, while still clearly reading as worn (a shoulder, a forearm, fabric folds, natural skin texture at the edge of frame). Combines desire/projection with readability of the personalized detail. Warm natural light, 35mm film aesthetic, soft focus background. Vertical 2:3 composition.

association.label: Association — flatlay groupé (déclinaisons)
association.role: Montre la gamme/déclinaisons → invite à épingler les variantes, multiplie les mots-clés.
association.prompt: ASSOCIATION FLATLAY — styled editorial flat lay grouping SEVERAL pieces of the SAME embroidered product in different colorways, arranged together as a cohesive product family (in the spirit of an Émoï-Émoï grouped flatlay: 2 to 4 pieces overlapping naturally). NO person, NO face. Warm textured surface (raw linen, pale wood), tasteful natural props (dried flowers, ceramic, a linen napkin), warm directional light, soft shadows. Each piece carries the SAME flat fine embroidery. Subtle, natural, desirable — it should make the viewer want to pin the whole range. Vertical 2:3 composition.

lifestyle.label: Lifestyle — scène de vie
lifestyle.role: Ancre le produit dans un quotidien aspirationnel (slow living), pinnable en inspiration.
lifestyle.prompt: LIFESTYLE SCENE — the embroidered product naturally integrated into a warm, lived-in scene (a set table, a sunny windowsill, a cozy interior, a morning coffee moment, gentle daylight). Editorial slow-living mood, 35mm film aesthetic. The product is clearly present and its embroidery legible, but woven into the scene rather than centered. A partial human presence (a hand, a shoulder, someone reaching) is welcome but never posed. Vertical 2:3 composition. Subtle and aspirational, like an Émoï-Émoï / Sézane lifestyle pin.
